labels.C: the line says the record does not show the canvas calls to be jokes, false or insincere
labels.T: the line says the record shows less of the joke than K01 names: no takeover, fake news, makeover or parody of the whole sub shown
labels.S: the line narrows the sub's April Fools styling: its change, its keeping or its being switched off not shown
labels.D: the line leaves the truth or the authorship of one claim open
labels.E: the line places the joke outside the room: a company, channel, platform or another server made it, and the room reacted
labels.W: the line bounds the joke's day: play run before the day, or a late joke refused for the date
labels.X: the line says the joke reached the canvas work
